name: Angereds kyrka - Fontin
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage; part of the STF Signaturled Goteborg context, with urban/rural transitions, protected-area segments and no official alternate geometry found

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 6. Angereds kyrka - Fontin
keyFacts: Canonical current name is Angereds kyrka - Fontin.
Official WST slug is 6-angereds-kyrka-fontin.
Official distance is 17 km / 17000 m.
Official estimated time is 5-6 h.
Official difficulty is blue / medium.
Stage runs from Angereds kyrka in Goteborg to Fontin in Kungalv.

Route starts in agricultural land near Angered, crosses Larjean, enters woods and Vattlefjall, continues through Bohus, crosses Gota alv on Jordfallsbron, passes Fastningsholmen/Bohus fastning, continues through old Kungalv and ends at Fontin recreation centre/nature reserve.
Official access notes identify Angereds kyrka bus stop near the start, Bohus/Eriksdal and Bohus station mid-stage, and Fardevagen/Fontin access near the end.
WST notes Stages 2-6 are part of the STF Signaturled Goteborg context.
No stage-specific closure/reroute warning was visible on the stage page during the 2026-04-29 source pass; county-level forest-fire-risk banner was active.

notes: National rule 1 March-20 August: dogs must be prevented from running loose where wildlife may be present; reserve rules are stricter in Vattlefjall, Fontin and Gota/Nordre.
Stage passes farms/meadows near Angered/Larjean; keep dogs leashed around livestock, close gates and avoid close livestock crossings.
Kungalv local rules require dogs leashed on public cycle/footways, squares, parks and similar areas, and dogs are not allowed at public bathing places/playgrounds.
Gota alv and Larjean are sensitive water/Natura corridors; avoid pollution.
Former Gota alv/Vanersborgsviken water-protection area was repealed by government decision 2025-04-03; no current formal GAVSO hiker restrictions were found in this pass.
Surtesjon official bathing water had 2025 classification for the 2026 season as excellent and latest 2025 sample tjanligt.
Gaddevattnet appears to be wild bathing, not confirmed as municipal sampled bathing water; check algae/signage.
Fishing generally requires local permit/landowner consent; Vattlefjall fishing permits are referenced via Fiskekort/iFiske.

De-duplicate WST/Hoodin GPX repeated coordinates before geometry processing.

Cluster Stora Molnesjon, Skarsjolund, Gaddvattnet, Bohus fortress/Kungalv services and Fontin/Kotten amenities to avoid duplicate POIs.

Keep Angered water, Bohus fortress public water/toilet, Skyrjon west lean-tos and Fontin viewpoint/grill pending until coordinate/access verification.
Model Kolebacka overnight cabin as a Stage 6 endpoint connection or Stage 7 facility, not a Stage 6 mainline facility.
